text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
What's going on, Shakur? Why did you
ask to
borrow my phone earlier?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I put an app I made on it. There, that
icon.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Huh... "Happy birthday"? Oh, is this
perhaps your
birthday present to me?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Wow, this is amazing! There are shiny
four-leaf
clovers spreading all over the
screen!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The lighting's all programmatically
generated.
Those clovers won't wither,
and you won't have to
waste time
searching for them, either.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Aww, but that time I spend searching for
them
always becomes a happy memory
in the end.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I'm incredibly happy to have
these ones
too. I'll treasure the clovers
you gave me,
Shakur! ♪
